description.value: The giant axons harvested from cave worms stretch alongside your own nervous system and carry signals from your brain that maintain your momentum. When you begin your turn with the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Slowed] condition or a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Stunned] condition that has a value, you become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Quickened] until the end of your next turn. You can use the action to Step or Stride. You can instead Burrow, Climb, Fly, or Swim if you have the appropriate Speed.
